text:
maria.le: heads up, the RBAC refactor that merged in `platform/rbac` is causing admin 403s in several Dedicated/Private test tenants when they try to open the control plane console or unwrap KMS keys. started hitting this ~09:08 PT.
ajay.k: ugh. which permission is failing? any logs from the control plane when trying to open the console?
maria.le: paste from controlplane logs: `2026-02-10T16:08:23Z ERROR auth: request denied principal=svcacct:tenant-42 action=controlplane.console.open reason=missing_permission role=priv_admin`
nikhil.r: that role (`priv_admin`) was part of the role rename in the refactor (we replaced `priv_admin` -> `onprem_superuser` in most CRs). sounds like some tenants still reference the old role in allowlists / rolebindings.
claire-sre: also seeing KMS unwrap fails: `kms: AccessDenied: the grantee does not have kms:Decrypt on key alias/ri/private/tenant-42`. Could be the KMS binding got scoped to `onprem_superuser` and the binding wasn't applied to the old svcacct.
ajay.k: deploy-bot shows the rbac refactor deploy completed at 09:02 PT: `deploy-bot: deploy platform@main -> staging SUCCESS (commit a7f2d1)`. Did the migration job that creates alias mappings run?
maria.le: migration job `rbac/role-compat` ran but logs show some CRs errored: `error: ownerReferences mismatch for tenant-42-binding`. maybe the job skipped tenants on failure.
nikhil.r: immediate mitigation: add a temporary shim rolebinding that maps old role names to new role names for all affected tenants. low-risk patch. who can push?
claire-sre: I can patch staging manifests. need exact rolebinding snippet.
maria.le: snippet that worked for tenant-42 (apply as patch):
```
apiVersion: rbac.redwood.com/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: tenant-42-legacy-priv-admin-shim
  namespace: tenant-42
subjects:
  - kind: ServiceAccount
    name: tenant-42-admin
roleRef:
  apiGroup: rbac.redwood.com
  kind: Role
  name: onprem_superuser
```

ajay.k: add an annotation so the migration job can detect and remove shims later: `rbac.redwood.com/compat-shim: "true"`.
claire-sre: applied shim to staging tenants 42/57/99. testing console open now.
(2m later)
claire-sre: quick smoke: console opens, KMS unwrap returns 200 for tenant-42. :thumbsup:
maria.le: great. can we get auditsvc to dump the audit trail for failed unwraps + rolebinding changes so we can triage which tenants were skipped?
auditsvc: last 24h events for principal=tenant-42-admin where action contains KMS or RoleBinding:
- 2026-02-10T08:05:11Z ROLEBINDING_UPDATE tenant-42-admin roleRef=priv_admin status=FAIL reason=owner_ref_mismatch
- 2026-02-10T09:07:59Z KMS_DECRYPT_FAIL tenant-42-admin key=alias/ri/private/tenant-42 error=AccessDenied
- 2026-02-10T09:12:05Z ROLEBINDING_CREATE tenant-42-admin roleRef=onprem_superuser status=SUCCESS
nikhil.r: looks like migration retried but partially succeeded; some tenants never got the create. Need to harden the migration: 1) make it idempotent, 2) add retry w/backoff per tenant, 3) write failed-tenants list to S3 for manual follow-up.
ajay.k: agree. also add a pre-deploy check that compares current rolebindings across a sampled set of tenants and fails CI if diffs exceed threshold. prevents mass breakages.
claire-sre: opened GH issue: redwood/platform#4821 `rbac: make migration idempotent + retry + reporting`.
maria.le: ticketed internal incident and notified support. external mitigation: email sent to affected accounts about short outage and that we applied a shim (no keys were exposed).
ikhil.r: followups: patch migration job, run in dry-run across all staging tenants, and schedule a maintenance window for production migration. also we should add a KMS policy audit step so key aliases with owner refs are verified before role rename.
ajay.k: assigning: nik@infra to fix migration code, claire to run staging dry-run, maria to coordinate tenant communication and postmortem.
maria.le: thanks. will update this thread with prod rollout plan. :face_with_raised_eyebrow:
(15m later)
maria.le: prod rollout scheduled for 2026-02-11 01:00 UTC with rollback guard. will document the verification steps (console open + kms decrypt + audit event present).
nikhil.r: after prod run we'll run a key-rotation check to ensure KMS keys weren't inadvertently re-scoped.
claire-sre: reported success in prod: 2026-02-11T01:12:45Z migration completed, no further 403/KMS errors in sampled tenants. rolling monitor for 3h. :white_check_mark:
